Name: Nyang Cat Scarecrows for Alternative Textures
Author: Morghoula
Description:
[center][color=#674ea7][size=4][b]This is a conversion of hushsmile's Nyang Cat Scarecrows for Alternative Textures. Permission has been obtained from the original artist to upload this conversion.[/b][/size][/color][/center][center]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center][img]https://i.ibb.co/TYnKKqg/features.png[/img]

[*]A total of 19 adorable cat sprites that work with normal Scarecrows, Rarecrows, and Deluxe Scarecrows. Mix and match your kitties to your heart's content!
[/list]
